paragraphs: SCRAM Systems sells monitoring technology, drug testing, software, and services for supervision programs. The electronic monitoring side covers GPS, alcohol, and remote breath tools for programs that need added visibility or testing. The software side covers dashboards, alerts, reports, and workflows for managing caseload activity.

The solutions page groups the offerings by program, with monitoring offered to courts that manage pretrial risk and enforce supervision conditions. Probation and parole agencies are offered monitoring technology and automated reporting for caseload management and compliance. State and county DUI/DWI programs are another named audience for the alcohol monitoring.

The case studies page presents results from agencies using the technology in their supervision programs. Sheriffs, pretrial directors, and probation leaders are the roles that page says the company equips.

quote.text: SCRAM brings together monitoring technology, drug testing, software, services, and support so teams can manage compliance with more clarity.
